Chapter 1311 - 50: The Fallen Lord Of Heaven Light (End Of This Volume)

Chapter 1311: Chapter 50: The Fallen Lord of Heaven Light (End of This Volume)

The Master of Infinite’s gaze turned nostalgic: "Speaking of which, should I count myself as a disciple of the Lord of Heaven Light? When this heaven and earth was born, I fought with other beings for resources."

"Just as I was about to die, the Lord of Heaven Light appeared. It was He who saved me."

Lin Yuan listened, reflecting on how when the Origin Source World was born, many exceptionally powerful beings were nurtured, and fighting began from that time.

"At the time, the Lord of Heaven Light was radiating infinite light all over. I found it very warm and comfortable, and hence, thought of following Him."

"But unfortunately, the Lord of Heaven Light did not agree. He transmitted some cultivation methods into my soul, including those about the Rune Dao, and then He left."

"I had complete cultivation methods, and my strength advanced quickly."

After a pause, the Master of Infinite continued, "Later, I heard more information related to the Lord of Heaven Light. He traveled across this heaven and earth, spreading cultivation methods, making the path ahead clear to all beings, and laying the foundation of the cultivation system."

"My strength grew continuously stronger, and I always went when the Lord of Heaven Light preached."

"Once, after He finished preaching, He didn’t leave. So I gathered the courage to go forward and ask why He was doing this? Why spread the precious cultivation methods to the masses?"

Lin Yuan nodded slightly at this.

He also had this doubt.

Cultivation methods are precious, especially those involving the Rune Dao, which touches upon the essence of the Dao.

Spreading them to all beings for no reason? Could it be just because of mercy?

Lin Yuan spreads the branches of Martial Arts Evolution Road, also to reinforce the external ’anchor,’ enhancing the possibility of breaking through time cycles.

But why does the Lord of Heaven Light do it?

At the level of time beings, mercy and evil are inconsequential, everything is about one’s own path.

Take the Lord of Heaven Light, He has a body that shines with compassion for all beings, but also a cold and indifferent Black Demon form.

Through the Black Demon form, Lin Yuan realized that the Lord of Heaven Light isn’t truly purely merciful.

So-called mercy is about actions done only when one’s own interests aren’t involved.

Time beings can observe future timelines; their so-called mercy is most likely a choice made after viewing numerous future timelines.

"At the time, the Lord of Heaven Light said, this is a debt He owes to the beings of this world in the future, so He is repaying it in advance, concluding the cause and effect."

The Master of Infinite said softly, "At the time, I didn’t understand the meaning of this statement, a debt to future beings of this world?"

Lin Yuan listened intently, his expression thoughtful.

The other twelve Eternal Lords remained silent.

In terms of knowledge about the Lord of Heaven Light, the Master of Infinite far exceeds them.

"Later on, I don’t know how much time passed, and I finally became an Eternal Lord, becoming a presence in this heaven and earth second only to the Lord of Heaven Light." The Master of Infinite said.

Lin Yuan nodded.

If the Lord of Heaven Light is counted, the Master of Infinite is the second Eternal Lord of this Origin Source World.

"After I became an Eternal Lord, the Lord of Heaven Light personally came to me and chatted for a long time. I learned that the Lord of Heaven Light is not a life of this world; He came from the dimensional gaps and discovered this heaven and earth by accident, sensing hints of perfect breath. Therefore, He waited outside for a complete cataclysm cycle."

"Finally, after paying a great price, He took advantage of the time when this heaven and earth was just born, when the world consciousness was initially awakening, coupled with the fact that no other Eternal Lords noticed, to successfully integrate into it."

The Master of Infinite said.

"So, that’s how it is."

Lin Yuan’s speculation was confirmed.

The strength of the Lord of Heaven Light is almost a fault with the subsequent thirteen Eternal Lords.

Among the six ancestors of the first Origin Source World, the strongest is the Da Fu Ancestor. Although there’s a gap in strength between Da Fu Ancestor and the other five ancestors, it’s not that wide.

In Lin Yuan’s eyes, the Lord of Heaven Light is almost certainly a Time Lord, and during a complete cataclysm cycle of a dimensional space world, it’s very difficult to nurture a Time Lord.

Almost all Time Lords attain their position by wandering the dimensional gaps for countless ages after the cataclysm of their native dimensional space world, and then attaining insights on how to consolidate their own timelines.

"Our world contains a hint of perfect breath, which is very important to the Lord of Heaven Light, useful for Him to impact that step."

The Master of Infinite said.

"Perfect breath?"

Lin Yuan’s expression was thoughtful.

At the same time, he vaguely realized that this could be the special feature of the Origin Source World.

In terms of strength and the number of time beings nurtured, Chaos Void is not weaker than the Origin Source World.

But Chaos Void is not the Origin Source World, and deep within the Myriad Realms Gate, there are uniquely thirty-three coordinates of Origin Source Worlds?

The endless dimensional dimensions, some dimensional spaces comparable to Chaos Void certainly exceed thirty-three, but why does the Myriad Realms Gate designate only these thirty-three worlds as Origin Source Worlds.

It likely relates to the perfect breath.

Lin Yuan experienced various dimensional spaces, even watched the operation of the first Origin Source World Origin Source, and noticed that the Origin Source World is very close to perfection, surpassing Chaos Void considerably in this respect.

Of course, this perfection is only the perfection of the world itself, it doesn’t significantly help in enhancing the nurture of life.

"Yes, the Lord of Heaven Light said that in the future, when He impacts that step, leveraging this hint of perfect breath, perhaps He can see further." The Master of Infinite said.

"See further..."

Lin Yuan thought about the Lord of Heaven Light’s depiction of impacting the Fourteenth Rank Perfect Time Being.

Can, is can.

If not, no matter how hard you try, it’s still not.

But now, leveraging this hint of perfect breath, He could see further?

Perhaps seeing further here doesn’t help in the breakthrough to Fourteenth Rank, but rather allows the time being to know clearly whether they can evolve into the Perfect Time Being?

"Later on, Black Space, Wu Shan and the others also gradually became Eternal Lords."

The Master of Infinite looked at the twelve Eternal Lords behind him.

"After thirteen Eternal Lords were born in this heaven and earth, the Lord of Heaven Light called us all together and said He was preparing to impact that step."

The Master of Infinite sighed.

"Attempting that step?"

Lin Yuan was shocked.

Does this mean the Lord of Heaven Light intends to attempt to become a Perfect Time Being of the Fourteenth Rank?

"Indeed."

"The Lord of Heaven Light attempted in front of us thirteen."

The Master of Black Space spoke up to add.

"What was the result?"

Lin Yuan immediately asked.

Soon realizing that this question was pointless.

The result must have been a failure, otherwise, if the Lord of Heaven Light had transformed into a Perfect Time Being, the Fang Yuan World wouldn’t have fallen into its current state.

"The result..."

The Master of Infinite fell silent for a moment, "I watched the mind and consciousness of the Lord of Heaven Light sublime and then burn, that extreme brilliance causing even the timeline to become rapidly chaotic."

"In the end, the mind and will of the Lord of Heaven Light vanished, unknown whether it was burned out or erased out of thin air."

The Master of Infinite looked at Lin Yuan and continued, "It’s a pity I never got to call the Lord of Heaven Light my teacher; the Lord of Heaven Light said that his guidance to us was a debt owed to the future, and there was no need to be acknowledged as a master."

"And then?"

Lin Yuan continued to inquire.

"Then... without the mind and will of the Lord of Heaven Light to suppress it, his body quickly lost control, and both his Black Demon form and Light form, driven by instinct, began to wantonly devour this world."

The Master of Black Space spoke up, "We joined forces to combat it, only to find that we could only accelerate this world’s destruction. After observing countless timelines, we finally drew away the Light form of the Lord of Heaven Light, and only by doing so could we leave a glimmer of hope for the future."

"Did the Lord of Heaven Light know that attempting that step would lead to such a result?" Lin Yuan asked.

"I think he didn’t know." The Master of Infinite shook his head, "Attempting to become a Perfect Time Being is not within a timeline, it can’t be observed through a timeline. The Lord of Heaven Light was willing to enlighten the beings of this world in exchange for the opportunity to attempt to become a Perfect Time Being here. As for the consequences of the attempt? Unpredictable."

"We only observed this situation after the Light form and Black Demon form of the Lord of Heaven Light lost control and fell back into the timeline, leading us to set up a series of arrangements."

The Master of Infinite said.

...

The eyes of the thirteen Eternal Lords were filled with complexity and fear.

Even as strong as the Lord of Heaven Light, he also lost his mind and will during the attempt to become a Perfect Time Being, a result no Time Lord is willing to accept.

"The Lord of Heaven Light, could he be considered fallen now?"

The Master of Infinite spoke softly.

If he hadn’t fallen, with the character of the Lord of Heaven Light, he would not tolerate such loss of control of his two true forms.

"Fallen?"

Lin Yuan sighed inwardly.

For a Time Lord like the Lord of Heaven Light, perhaps only attempting to become a Perfect Time Being could lead to their complete demise.

"Perfect Time Being?"

Lin Yuan gained a new understanding of this level of existence.

Time Lords are able to observe each timeline, and the more they observe, the more their own insignificance becomes evident, fueling their desire to transform into a Perfect Time Being that thoroughly understands all timelines.

"Galaxy friend, we should leave now."

At this moment, the Master of Infinite glanced around at the gradually seething Demonic Qi, a vague figure had begun to manifest, it was the Demon God.

Similarly, outside the Origin World, in the time and space filled with infinite light, clusters of light were also stirring, evidently responding to the descent of the thirteen Eternal Lords, causing different degrees of reaction from the Light form and Black Demon form of the Lord of Heaven Light.

"Alright."

Lin Yuan nodded.

"I’ve already ordered the major Eternal Sects to follow your commands, Galaxy friend."

The Master of Infinite said.

The other Eternal Lords had no objections.

In simple terms, from this moment until the end of the demonic calamity, Lin Yuan would be the sole ruler of this Origin World, his words carrying more authority than those of the Eternal Lords.

"The next time we meet, Galaxy friend will be a Time Lord."

"Yes, we shall meet again when we are Time Lords."

One by one, the Eternal Lords said before their descending avatars quickly dissipated.

With the disappearance of the thirteen avatars, the Demonic Qi that had been gradually boiling from all directions settled down once again.

"Meet again when we are Time Lords?"

A smile appeared on Lin Yuan’s face.

He then once again immersed himself in cultivation.
